description:
Get state-level programs and laws that help with hospital bills in one state, with source URLs and quotes.
Use it when the patient's hospital has no policy data, when the hospital is for-profit, or when they ask what their state offers.
Takes a two-letter state code. Each program has an applies_to field, because a state program may cover only some hospitals.

state.description: Two-letter US state code, for example "MA".

name: get_state_programs
title: State programs and laws
